name: degraded_key
description: Common degraded coverage causes and audit counters. Registered feed and insight-view identifiers remain owned by their registries; Core validates those subjects without collapsing their counts into generic causes.

definitions.quota-deferred: Coverage was deferred by the source's quota.
definitions.unsupported-host: The repository's forge host is unsupported.
definitions.no-repo-url: The observation has no repository URL.
definitions.no-credentials: Required source credentials were unavailable or refused.
definitions.unreachable: The source could not be reached.
definitions.error: A source observation failed or its reply was invalid.
definitions.ban-suspected: Coverage was skipped because a source ban or secondary rate limit is suspected.
definitions.network-skipped: The run did not permit network observation.
definitions.db-missing: The pinned scanner has no usable vulnerability database.
definitions.db-stale: The pinned scanner's vulnerability database is stale.
definitions.db-version-mismatch: The vulnerability database does not match the pinned scanner version.
definitions.failed: Ledger audit counter: layers whose integrity verification failed.
definitions.unverified: Ledger audit counter: layers that could not be independently verified.

standard.none: Project-defined operational coverage vocabulary; existing spellings and subject identifiers are preserved.

note: The schema's pattern remains historical-compatible. New Core completions accept this vocabulary or identifiers from the registered feed/view domains, and require positive integer counts. Healthy observation outcomes are not degraded causes.
